source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The owned fix makes destination-subfolder existence and message counts direct assertions:3messages after move and 2after copy, with separate mock-server count checks. The setup also gives the parent messages, covering the combined parent-and-child case. The test already says its top-level copy signal can precede descendant completion; accepted code later waits for child counts. These assertions do not prove a live server result or make the old250ms delay a completion contract.
title: Folder-copy tests assert descendants separately from the top-level copy signal
